notes.title: Achievements added! Sequel released! Upgrades!
notes.notes:
We have added 4 achievements to the game. See if you can get them all! There have been graphical upgrades to improve user experience as well. Can you find the extra note? 

For those who have been living under a rock, the sequel has been released and the critics have agreed it's a "slam bang bing bong" adventure! Check out Legacy Of Epstein: Foul Dreamer:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2911160/Legacy_of_Epstein_Foul_Dreamer/]Legacy Of Epstein: Foul Dreamer[/url]
